label: Something that is GOD_4 has being and is exceeded in being by something that is not GOD_4
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed (motivated by demiurgic and finite-god theologies): for some g and y, g is God, g is in act in esse, y is not God, and y is more in esse than g. It is not atheism and does not say that God lacks being.
